title: Enterprise Architect, Global IT
searchText: Enterprise Architect, Global IT Rubrik Job Board About the team and role: We are seeking a highly experienced and strategic and visionary Enterprise Architect to join our Rubrik IT Enterprise Architecture team, focusing on the intersection of our IT Enterprise Applications, Integrations, Automations, Data, Cloud, AI, and Security with our robust Information Security policies and the Risk control frameworks. This role is critical for aligning our IT technical vision and strategy with our business goals and corporate objectives ensuring the delivery of scalable, secure, and resilient platforms for our internal IT teams and Business Operations teams. The ideal candidate will have deep expertise in enterprise architecture, integration patterns, full-stack engineering solutions, Cloud, DevOps, and cybersecurity principles. Your role will bridge the gap between business objectives and technical execution, ensuring that all architectural decisions align with our Business operations strategies and guiding principles. What you'll do: Strategy and Roadmap Business-IT Alignment: Translate the overall business strategy (goals, objectives, and priorities) into a coherent, executable IT strategy and architecture vision. Architectural Vision: Define and maintain the Target State Architecture (Future State) for the entire enterprise, encompassing Business, Data, Application, and Technology domains. Roadmapping: Develop and govern the multi-year Architectural Roadmap that guides the transition from the current-state architecture (Baseline) to the target state, prioritizing initiatives to maximize business value. Technology Evaluation: Conduct horizon scanning and evaluate emerging technologies (e.g., AI, Cloud services, new security platforms) to determine their potential impact and strategic fit for the business. Governance and Standards Architectural Governance: Establish, enforce, and maintain Architectural Principles, Decision Trees, Standards, and Enterprise Patterns across the organization to ensure consistency, quality, and interoperability. Review and Assurance: Lead the Architecture Review Council (ARC) process to review and approve all major IT projects, tools and solutions, ensuring compliance with defined standards and the overall enterprise vision by meeting periodically with the identified federated domain and solution architects and/or business process owners or architects Risk and Compliance: Ensure all architectural designs inherently comply with regulatory requirements (e.g., GDPR, SOC 2, SOX, FedRAMP, and industry-specific standards) and address technical risks like security vulnerabilities and scalability limitations by partnering with InfoSec, Internal Audit, Legal and Privacy teams Design and Guidance Blueprint Creation: Create, document, and maintain essential architectural artifacts and models (e.g., using frameworks like TOGAF or Archimate) to provide a holistic view of the enterprise. Complexity Reduction: Identify and drive initiatives to rationalize the existing application portfolio, reduce technical debt, and simplify the overall IT landscape to improve agility and reduce costs. Cross-Domain Leadership: Provide technical and strategic direction to solution architects, domain architects (Applications, Integrations, Automations, Cloud, AI, Data, Security, Infrastructure), and delivery teams on complex, cross-functional programs. Stakeholder Management and Communication Stakeholder Alignment: Collaborate with senior leaders, and ITLT (IT Leadership Team) members, and business Ops leaders to articulate the value of architecture and align technology investment decisions with organizational priorities. Communication: Clearly articulate and present complex technical concepts, trade-offs, and architectural decisions to both technical and non-technical audiences. Mentorship: Mentor and coach other federated architects and technical staff on best practices, strategic thinking, and the application of architectural standards. Experience You’ll Need: Experience: 15+ years in Information Technology, with at least 5 years in an Enterprise Architect or equivalent senior architectural role. Domain Expertise: Proven experience in designing and implementing architectures for B2B platforms, including APIs, integration patterns (e.g., EDI, message queuing, event-driven), Experienced in providing solution architecture to the GTM, G&A Finance, Legal, Customer Support business functions Cybersecurity Acumen: Deep understanding of core cybersecurity domains (e.g., threat modeling, network security, application security, cloud security, and data encryption). Technical Skills: Expertise with Integrations, Automations, GenAI, Cloud Native Architectures (e.g., AWS, Azure, GCP), microservices, Event Driven Architectures, containerization (Docker, Kubernetes), APIs, and DevOps/CI/CD pipelines. Frameworks: Strong knowledge of architecture frameworks such as TOGAF or the Zachman Framework. Certifications (Preferred): Relevant certifications such as CISSP, CISM, Certified Cloud Architect (e.g., AWS Certified Solutions Architect - Professional), or Open Group Certified Architect (TOGAF). Join Us in Securing the World's Data Rubrik (RBRK), the Security and AI Operations Company, leads at the intersection of data protection, cyber resilience, and enterprise AI acceleration. Rubrik Security Cloud delivers complete cyber resilience by securing, monitoring, and recovering data, identities, and workloads across clouds. Rubrik Agent Cloud accelerates trusted AI agent deployments at scale by monitoring and auditing agentic actions, enforcing real-time guardrails, fine-tuning for accuracy and undoing agentic mistakes. Linkedin | X (formerly Twitter) | Instagram | Rubrik.com Inclusion @ Rubrik At Rubrik, we are dedicated to fostering a culture where people from all backgrounds are valued, feel they belong, and believe they can succeed. Our commitment to inclusion is at the heart of our mission to secure the world’s data. Our goal is to hire and promote the best talent, regardless of background. We continually review our hiring practices to ensure fairness and strive to create an environment where every employee has equal access to opportunities for growth and excellence. We believe in empowering everyone to bring their authentic selves to work and achieve their fullest potential. Our inclusion strategy focuses on three core areas of our business and culture: Our Company: We are committed to building a merit-based organization that offers equal access to growth and success for all employees globally. Your potential is limitless here. Our Culture: We strive to create an inclusive atmosphere where individuals from all backgrounds feel a strong sense of belonging, can thrive, and do their best work. Your contributions help us innovate and break boundaries. Our Communities: We are dedicated to expanding our engagement with the communities we operate in, creating opportunities for underrepresented talent and driving greater innovation for our clients. Your impact extends beyond Rubrik, contributing to safer and stronger communities. Equal Opportunity Employer/Veterans/Disabled Rubrik is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, or protected veteran status and will not be discriminated against on the basis of disability. Rubrik provides equal employment opportunities (EEO) to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability or genetics. In addition to federal law requirements, Rubrik complies with applicable state and local laws governing nondiscrimination in employment in every location in which the company has facilities. This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including recruiting, hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfer, leaves of absence, compensation and training. Federal law requires employers to provide reasonable accommodation to qualified individuals with disabilities. Please contact us at hr@rubrik.com if you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job or to perform your job. Examples of reasonable accommodation include making a change to the application process or work procedures, providing documents in an alternate format, using a sign language interpreter, or using specialized equipment.
